basis: Exhaustive public-main registration and declarations, compared against actual released catalog and complete source diff. No current source build or exact-current execution claimed.
review: Exactly 10 scalar names, including three named variants of PerceptualHash; no tables/views/macros/authentication/write APIs. Parameters and return types unchanged. Most changes are metadata/examples; one substantive change adds a no-upscale guard to imaging::thumbnail and a regression test. Both thumbnail and thumbnail_fit use it. Default demonstrated thumbnail outputs shrink the 160×120 fixture and are unaffected; larger 240-pixel experiment intentionally measures old release upscaling. Current implementation would keep 160×120. No behavior equivalence claimed for that case; all current mappings are interface compatibility reviews, not current runtime execution.
